name: @keyban/cli

tools.name: setup_instructions
tools.description: This Keyban agent wallet has no wallet to drive yet, so none of its usual tools are available. Incomplete configuration: KEYBAN_API_KEY, KEYBAN_APP_ID, KEYBAN_WALLET_ADDRESS, KEYBAN_INVITE_KEY, KEYBAN_NETWORK. Call this tool for the steps to obtain those values from keyban.io.

annotations.title: How to finish setting up this wallet

tools.name: get_wallet_instructions
tools.description: Return the guide to follow with this server (the keyban-agent-wallet skill): funding the wallet, paying x402 APIs, transferring USDC, waiting for a human approval, reading a policy refusal. Call it before the first payment, or whenever a wallet operation is unclear. Creating and configuring the wallet is the Keyban admin MCP guide instead.

tools.name: list_my_wallets
tools.description: List the wallets kept on this machine (by keyban wallet import): id, name, address, network, funding, which one is current (driven here) and which one is the default (driven by the CLI and every later start). Switch with use_wallet.

tools.name: use_wallet
tools.description: Drive another kept wallet from now on, in this server only unless global. The wallet tools are reloaded for it. Refused while a payment waits for approval, or for an incomplete wallet.

wallet.description: name or id of a kept wallet, as list_my_wallets shows them

global.description: also make it the default wallet: the CLI's and every server's started later

instructions: Keyban agent wallet MCP server — NOT USABLE YET. It drives a wallet that Keyban provisions, and its configuration is incomplete: KEYBAN_API_KEY, KEYBAN_APP_ID, KEYBAN_WALLET_ADDRESS, KEYBAN_INVITE_KEY, KEYBAN_NETWORK. None of the wallet tools are available until that is fixed. Tell the user to create an agent wallet at https://keyban.io, and call setup_instructions for the steps.
stderr: keyban sends diagnostic events (startup and failures, no secrets) to Keyban, with an installation id and your wallet's app id and address. Set KEYBAN_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 to turn it off. Details: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@keyban/cli#telemetry
